summary: The PMO's Sept. 3, 2026 published chronology states Netanyahu was first alerted at 06:29, received a second update at 06:44, left for the Kirya at 07:30 and held the full assessment with the defense minister and senior security chiefs at 09:55.
notes: Fresh provenance recheck added the PMO's newly published minute-by-minute chronology, independently reported by Walla and others. It strengthens the factual timeline but still does not supply an official, judicial, audit or inquiry finding assigning Netanyahu individual responsibility for the operational timing. Preserve the PMO's reported early questions/instructions and competing reporting about transit/contact timing.
